A '''steel helmet''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], made by smithing an [[Iron Helmet|iron helmet]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It gives 2 armor and 1 toughness and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_helmet.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/steel/helmet</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 2 armor, 1 armor toughness and 0.1 knockback resistance (shown as 1 in the tooltip).

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Blast Protection]] II

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Steel equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Added translation support for all armor and tools. Steel armor names are shown in white.}}
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Added recipe unlocks for steel equipment.}}
{{History line|1.02|Steel alloy takes less time to blast.}}
{{History line|1.03|Steel alloy is now blasted from [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] instead of directly from iron.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
